text: The factor rho^2 sin(phi) appearing in the spherical-coordinate volume element dV = rho^2 sin(phi) d(rho) d(phi) d(theta) is the absolute value of the ___ determinant of the coordinate transformation.
explanation: The Jacobian determinant of the spherical transformation is rho^2 sin(phi), which converts (rho, phi, theta) volume into Cartesian volume. Omitting this factor is a common error when setting up triple integrals in spherical coordinates.
